name: @backwork/mcp
description: MCP server for Backwork: Medicare and payer medical policy, prior authorization, claim risk, and medical codes. Hosted OAuth remote or local stdio.

scripts.guard:release-tag: node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); const expected='v'+pkg.version; const actual=process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME; if (actual !== expected) { throw new Error('Release ref '+(actual || '<unset>')+' does not match package version '+expected); }"
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/mcp-http-auth-smoke.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-openapi-contract.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add server.json src/index.ts

author: Backwork LLC
